crossRefs.note: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through…
or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope…
Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of…
Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in…
that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

translations.web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
translations.bsb: Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,
translations.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
translations.asv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned unto him;
